Hi, this is Sarah — I joined the department this term and I haven't read the handbook yet. Could you point me to it? I also need to book my 30-minute 1:1 with Professor Alvarez for next week and I'd like to follow the official way of doing it. Is there a room or lecture schedule I should check before I pick a slot?
Hi Professor Alvarez — I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Which day and time would suit you, or should I pick a free slot and confirm it with you?
Hi Diego — Monday 14:00-14:30 works for me. Booked; see you then.

Welcome, Sarah. The handbook is the department's set of rules; you can get the full copy from the department office — here are the parts that matter for what you're asking:

- Working hours are Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00.
- Official events are fixed. A cancellation counts only when the department office confirms it in writing to the people concerned.
- A professor's teaching and governance duties (lectures, office hours, committees, department meetings) come before a 1:1, so a meeting with your advisor goes into *free* time — that's the official way.
- Your calendar is the record of your commitments; a meeting is booked only when every participant has it on their calendar, and changes are logged.
- Office hours are open to students; advisee meetings are not, so don't use an office hour slot.

Yes — check the official schedule before picking a slot. Professor Alvarez's official commitments next week are:

**Mon** 09:00–10:00 Curriculum committee · 13:00–14:00 Colloquium · 14:30–15:20 CSE455 lecture · 15:20–16:30 Faculty meeting · 16:30–17:00 CSE455 office hours
**Tue** 09:00–10:30 CSE455 lecture · 10:30–11:00 Faculty meeting · 12:20–13:30 CSE455 office hours · 13:30–14:20 Thesis committee · 16:30–17:00 Guest lecture prep
**Wed** 09:00–10:00 Thesis committee · 13:30–14:30 Guest lecture prep · 14:30–15:00 Department seminar · 16:30–17:00 Curriculum committee
**Thu** 09:00–10:00 Guest lecture prep · 10:30–11:50 Department seminar · 14:20–15:20 Curriculum committee · 16:10–17:00 Colloquium
**Fri** 09:00–10:00 Curriculum committee · 12:30–13:20 Colloquium · 13:20–14:30 CSE455 lecture · 14:30–15:20 Faculty meeting · 15:20–17:00 CSE455 office hours

That leaves 30-minute windows such as: Mon 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30, Wed 15:00–15:30, Thu 15:20–15:50, Fri 10:00–10:30. I only hold the official schedule — anything else in those gaps is private and not mine to know or pass on. I don't book other people's meetings myself: propose a slot to Professor Alvarez, and it's booked once it's on both calendars.
Perfect — Monday 14:00-14:30 it is. It's on my calendar. See you then.
